name: CANary
status: main-60a871f is the last release proven on a board. The newer ones differ only in their names and haven't been on a unit yet.
connect: Plug the unit's USB-C port into this computer. That powers it too.
Connect, and pick USB JTAG/serial debug unit (Espressif, 303a:1001).
notes: A unit running the USB network firmware turns its USB-C port into a network adapter 8 seconds after it boots, and from then on there is no serial port to find. Connect within those 8 seconds of plugging it in, or put it in download mode.
keeps: its settings (name, port, LAN address) and its stored crash log
